caption: The drawing depicts a single lidded glass dish, centrally positioned on a plain, light background. The dish has a round, wide bowl supported by a short, flared pedestal base. The lid of the dish features a knob-like handle at the top and has a gently domed shape with carved, repeating semi-circular or scallop patterns that are echoed along the sides of the bowl and the base. The entire object is rendered in shades of grey, utilizing fine lines and varied shading to create the illusion of transparency and reflective qualities characteristic of glass. There are no additional objects or embellishments in the composition, and the main subject appears to be a detailed study of the glass dish’s form and design.
title: Compote
